# Exotic Motorwerks

> Independent Porsche specialist in Scottsdale, Arizona. Since 2002. Every repair carries a 2-year warranty on parts and labor.

Concept note: this file is part of an unofficial Kerblabs design concept. Facts come from exoticmotorwerks.com. Confirm details with the business.

## Business
- Name: Exotic Motorwerks
- Founder: Dan Warner
- Address: 15035 N 74th St, Scottsdale, AZ 85260
- Phone: 602-820-2685
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 8 AM to 5 PM

## Services
- Pre-purchase inspections
- Engine diagnostics
- Brake service
- Scheduled maintenance
- Clutch and transmission service
- Cooling system repair

## Vehicles serviced
- Modern: 911, 718 Cayman and Boxster, Cayenne, Macan, Panamera, Taycan
- Classic: 924S, 944, 968, 928 (full-service maintenance and restoration)

## Booking
- Call 602-820-2685 during business hours.
